scope: Written acoustic designs only; no generated-audio or voice-identity validation.

withinFamilyContrastBasis.smoky_grain: Thin versus dense smoke, close versus broad body, continuous versus intermittent surface.
withinFamilyContrastBasis.dry_coarse_husky: Compact versus wide core, fine versus coarse dry friction, blunt versus bright rim.
withinFamilyContrastBasis.sustained_crackle: Fine versus large events, sparse versus dense timing, steady versus changing texture envelope.
withinFamilyContrastBasis.frayed_onset: Single versus paired/multiple starts, short versus extended fray, phrase-only versus repeated-note scope.
withinFamilyContrastBasis.creaking_endings: Fine versus coarse release, short versus long terminal creak, abrupt versus gradual narrowing.
withinFamilyContrastBasis.pitched_gravel: Discrete versus packed grains, fine versus blunt large grit, open versus compact pitched center.
withinFamilyContrastBasis.hollow_low_resonance: Lean versus heavy low body, small forward versus spacious rear cavity, dry versus softly airy rim.
withinFamilyContrastBasis.dense_dark_chest: Soft versus hard density, compact versus broad body, smooth versus grainy dark rim.
withinFamilyContrastBasis.woody_matte: Slender tube versus thick wood body, fine versus bristly fiber, covered versus open cavity.
withinFamilyContrastBasis.narrow_reed_nasal: Thin versus weighty core, muted versus bright nasal ridge, clean versus rough reed surface.
withinFamilyContrastBasis.metallic_ring: Thin focused versus broad ring, dark versus bright core, smooth versus abrasive edge.
withinFamilyContrastBasis.clear_rounded_resonance: Lean versus heavy clear body, small versus wide rounded cavity, dark versus bright spectral balance.

issues.problem: Delayed grain reveal was ambiguous against the shared instruction for grain throughout quiet vowels.
issues.resolution: Made faint grain present at onset and brought it forward halfway through the sustain.

issues.problem: Intermittent catches and return to a lean core conflicted with the shared throughout-vowel grain instruction.
issues.resolution: Kept the intended intermittent catch pattern and explicitly allowed the lean center between catches.

issues.problem: Texture wording allowed fraying at all onsets while the signature limited it to the first note.
issues.resolution: Restricted the texture wording to phrase-opening notes, matching the existing signature.

issues.problem: The hollow-low family used unqualified midrange cavity wording despite its low-middle register.
issues.resolution: Made the intended low-middle cavity color explicit while retaining slender dry nasal contrast.

issues.problem: The hollow-low family requested middle-register vowels without explicitly retaining low placement.

limits: Different written anchors and field strings do not prove different generated singers, recognizability, appeal, or consistent voice identity.
Acoustic descriptions are directional prompt hypotheses, not measured pitch, formant, harmonic, roughness, or physiological specifications.
No listening or media analysis occurred; rough upper/head-register requests and creaking endings may be ignored or shifted by the generation engine.
Artist screening detects references in this authored text; it does not establish globally unused provisional names or exhaustively search all performers.
